notes: Scroll-driven longread, 7 pinned canvas scenes morphing by scroll progress, drop caps, spectrum progress bar, per-chapter color temperature. No libraries, no console errors on desktop and mobile.
v1_issues: Fire core washed out to a white blob; near gas lamps blown out to huge white glare and near-camera windows rendered as giant flat rectangles; empty black hole in the centre of the laser mandala; progress-bar chapter labels not aligned with the track; 'g' descender clipped in hero title; heavy per-frame shadowBlur (neon) and per-bulb radial gradients (bulb grid) hurt FPS; on mobile the LED labels overlap.
v2_changes: Reworked flame particles (warmer sprites, taller tongues, separate hot core); capped and distance-faded gas lamp glows, hid near windows; laser centre filled with rotating conic spectrum + glow, thicker beams on small screens; labels aligned to the track, active-only labels on mobile; neon glow via downsampled bloom instead of shadowBlur; bulb glows via pre-tinted Kelvin sprites and simplified distant bulbs; canvas pixel budget (~3.7 MP) for retina/4K; stage edge fades + film grain; mobile card spacing and typography; hero descender fix.
